title: Blue Droplet Logo and Applications
whatItIs: A tall pale blue sheet with a step tag 'Logo Creation', a gradient headline about a symbol for control and movement, the blue droplet mark with wordmark 'GlucoCare' on guide lines, then browser-tab, home-screen icon and in-hand app mockups.
whatItMeans: A single blue droplet with a swirl feels medical yet friendly, and showing tab and icon proves it works small.

Guide lines framing the logo lock-up
